card_excerpts.text: - GLM-5.3 supports controlling the thinking budget through the `reasoning_effort` parameter, which accepts three levels: `low`, `high`, and `max`. It defaults to `max` if not passed (or if set to any other value). To use `low` or `high`, pass them explicitly. For benchmark and leaderboard reproduction, keep the default `max`.
